title: Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line Curtailment Schedule
content:
Curtailments are scheduled principal reductions on aged floored units of the Kestrel Dealer Wholesale Floorplan Line. Each Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade sets when the first curtailment on a new unit and on a used unit falls due, what percent of the original advance each curtailment takes, the days between curtailments, the age at which a used unit must be paid in full, and the monthly curtailment on dealer demonstrators.

## New units

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Days after advance when the first curtailment falls due | Curtailment at each date, percent of the original advance | Days between curtailments after the first |
|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | 180 | 10 | 30 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | 210 | 10 | 30 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | 240 | 10 | 60 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | 270 | 10 | 60 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | 300 | 10 | 90 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | 365 | 10 | 90 |

## Used units and demonstrators

| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade | Days after advance when the first used-unit curtailment falls due | Used-unit curtailment at each date, percent of the original advance | Days between used-unit curtailments | Days after which a used unit must be paid in full | Monthly curtailment on demonstrators, percent of the original advance |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 6 | 60 | 20 | 30 | 180 | 2.0 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 5 | 60 | 15 | 30 | 180 | 2.0 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 | 90 | 15 | 30 | 270 | 2.0 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 3 | 90 | 10 | 30 | 270 | 2.0 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 2 | 90 | 10 | 30 | 365 | 2.0 |
| Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 1 | 120 | 10 | 30 | 365 | 2.0 |

## Terms as defined for this schedule

- **New-unit curtailment start**: days after advance when the first curtailment on a new unit falls due.
- **New-unit curtailment percent**: curtailment percent of the original advance on a new unit at each curtailment date.
- **New-unit curtailment interval**: days between new-unit curtailments after the first.
- **Used-unit curtailment start**: days after advance when the first curtailment on a used unit falls due.
- **Used-unit curtailment percent**: curtailment percent of the original advance on a used unit at each curtailment date.
- **Used-unit curtailment interval**: days between used-unit curtailments.
- **Used-unit maximum floor time**: days after which a used unit must be paid in full.
- **Demonstrator curtailment**: monthly curtailment on demonstrator units, as a percent of the original advance.

## Reading the schedule

Every curtailment percent on this schedule is a percent of the unit's original advance, so each curtailment on a given unit at a given grade is the same amount. On hypothetical figures: a new unit advanced at 40000 USD on Kestrel Wholesale Risk Grade 4 owes 10 percent of 40000 USD, which is 4000 USD, at its first curtailment date 240 days after the advance and again at each date 60 days apart after that. The advance amount is an illustrative input only.
